approvalRule: Owner approval of a publisher at source level constitutes editorial approval of articles from that publisher, including articles in existing pilot batches. Individual editorial approval is not separately required. Source-specific exceptions may be flagged; source validity, claim accuracy, freshness, rights, and publication readiness are separate safeguards, not additional discretionary editorial approval.
